name: Dual-calm regime momentum — ride crypto trend only when VIX is low AND credit spreads are tight
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from the VIX-spike reversion lane): calm macro CONDITIONS crypto momentum to run. In low-vol, tight-credit regimes leverage is cheap and risk budgets are open, so trends persist BECAUSE the deleveraging tail is switched off — no VaR shock forces unwinds. The counterparty is the mean-reversion/vol-selling crowd that fades every up-move and gets steamrolled while credit stays tight. Take crypto momentum longs (positive ret_Nd) ONLY when vix_level is in a calm low band AND credit_spread is tight. The macro filter STANDS ASIDE during stress rather than predicting. DISCONFIRMER — most curve-fit-prone: 'calm' is a fitted threshold on a slow daily macro series, and momentum + calm overlap mechanically (calm periods ARE trending periods), so the gate may add ZERO information over a pure crypto-momentum baseline. Kill unless an ablation shows the vix+credit gate lifts OOS net-of-fee Sharpe vs the identical momentum spec WITHOUT the filter. If it only trims trades without improving risk-adjusted return it is a multiple-testing artifact.
catalyst: calm macro regime (low VIX, tight credit) with crypto momentum
